title: Teri Azaan Akbar
body:
Azaan sunn ke payamber ki yaad aati hai
Bala ke dasht ki Sarwar ki yaad aati hai
Hai ahle haqq ki zubaa par teri azaan Akbar
Baqaye deen e payamber teri azaan Akbar
Hai Karbala ka muqadaar teri azaan Akbar
1. Azaan may Ali Akbar ki noujawaani hai
Azaan zulm ke lashkar pe kaamrani hai
Sunayi degi sina par teri azaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tamam ahle haram ko azaan roolati thi
Tumhare biyah ki sehre ki yaad aati thi
Hum aaj rootay hain sunkar teri azaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Azaan karbobala se Madina jayegi
Azaan tumhari behan ko bahut rulayegi
Na bhool payegi qwaher teri azaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Wo kaise Zainab e muztar ko chain aayega
Jawan betay ke chehra bahut roolayega
Sunegi ashk bahakar teri azaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lahoo se kardiya shadab dekho Akbar ne
Jiger ka qoon diya hai jo ibne Sarwar ne
Zaeef hogi ye kyunkar teri azaan Akbar
Azz: shadab razvi
